protocol.question: Do runway geometry interacting with forecast winds, or recent FAA advisory activity, improve locally calibrated airport disruption forecasts?
protocol.selectionReason: Prespecified geographic and operational contrast, including a nearby hub/non-hub pair; not a representative national sample.
protocol.population: BTS reporting-carrier domestic scheduled airport events, not private-jet outcomes. Delay >=15 minutes, cancellation, and arrival diversion form the disruption target.

runwayVintage.rule: Freeze pre-training OurAirports true runway headings for paved runways listed open at this vintage. Do not use present-day closures, inferred active configurations, aircraft limits, or call inventory an operational capacity measure.

protocol.windRule: Recover wind direction from the exact cached TAF version used by the existing as-of extractor. Assert the original weather vector matches. Across overlapping prevailing and explicit conditional winds, use true directions and gusts. Variable wind gets an explicit unknown-direction feature and conservative gust-sized crosswind bound, not a calm assumption. The best-alignment feature is a geometry proxy, not the actual assigned or available runway. A direction-only control separates new wind information from geometry interactions.
protocol.faaRule: Parse complete, date-validated daily listings. Match exact airport control element for ground stop/GDP issue, revision, and cancellation messages. Use SEND TIME as UTC publication time, never the subsequently reported effective start. At each forecast cutoff replay the last hourly fetch, with a conservative additional 10-minute publication lag. Count message activity over the prior 6 and 24 hours and cancellation messages separately; this is not an active-program, unique-event, delay-duration, NOTAM, or universal-flight-applicability feature. Carrier-restricted notices remain aggregate airline activity signals, never private-jet restrictions. Require every UTC date spanning the 24-hour history to have a validated listing; missing archive coverage excludes the window from all variants, never means no restrictions.
protocol.learner: Fixed airport-local regularized logistic heads using existing v3 hyperparameters, with separate chronological sigmoid probability and 80% empirical outcome-rate band calibration for every variant. Fit/calibrate scalers only on training data. No pooled transfer, hyperparameter search, or promotion.
protocol.comparisons: All variants share identical eligible rows in each airport/direction/horizon slice. Report weatherRunway, weatherFaa, weatherRunwayFaa versus weather, and weatherRunway versus weatherDirection. Weather and direction-only versus calendar/weather are descriptive controls.
protocol.primaryMetric: Flight-event-weighted disruption Brier score; paired relative improvement versus the matched weather baseline.
protocol.uncertainty: 1000 paired three-day calendar-block bootstrap resamples. Share sampled calendar blocks across airports in aggregates. Approximate BH correction jointly over four experimental comparisons across all airport/direction/horizon slices, separately for winter and spring. Horizon aggregates have different eligible samples and are not causal horizon comparisons. No test-driven tuning.
protocol.testDisclosure: Both 2026 periods have already been inspected in earlier experiments. This is a frozen retrospective ablation, not a pristine confirmatory holdout. Final-vintage BTS outcomes and archival timestamps do not establish actual historical delivery. A future prospective evaluation and live feature parity are required for promotion.

budget.rule: Local cached public-data pilot only. Persist request reservations before sending, enforce byte and attempt caps across restarts, stop on rate limit/auth errors, retain failed dates as unknown. Three prior FAA probes and the one bounded 3.8 MB runway download are recorded separately in the source audit. Leave production files, AWS jobs, and the $20 monthly safeguards unchanged.

decision: Research only. No production promotion; prospective validation and live feature parity are required.
